scripts.build: npm run type-check && vite build --configLoader runner --config vite.config.axum.ts
scripts.type-check: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vitest.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:component
scripts.coverage:rust: mkdir -p backend/coverage && cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --lcov --remap-path-prefix --ignore-filename-regex tests/ --output-path backend/coverage/lcov.info && sed -i 's|^SF:|SF:backend/|' backend/coverage/lcov.info
scripts.test:sonar: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:rust && cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --all-targets --message-format=json -- -D warnings > backend/clippy-report.json && podman run --rm --userns=keep-id:uid=1000,gid=1000 --network host -e SONAR_TOKEN -e SONAR_HOST_URL="${SONAR_HOST_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:9000}" -v "$PWD:/usr/src:Z" docker.io/sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli:latest -Dproject.settings=sonar.properties
scripts.nas:package: npm run build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && nas-base-app package
